rationale: Both Shan and Haowen are deeply embedded in robotics with complementary expertise: Shan directs embodied AI and industrial robotics deployment at Ruyi Dynamics, while Haowen is a cofounder at Mach9 Robotics with specialized experience in robot manipulation, visual servoing, and low-level systems (C++, CUDA). They share core technical domains in computer vision and robotics, and could explore how Mach9's manipulation capabilities and systems expertise might intersect with Ruyi's deployment focus in industrial environments.
intro_message: Shan, meet Haowen Shi — cofounder of Mach9 Robotics with deep expertise in robot manipulation and computer vision; given your work deploying embodied AI systems at Ruyi Dynamics, you two should compare notes on the robotics stack.
